text: DirecTV is now wholly owned by TPG Capital, the US/European private-equity platform of TPG Inc., which completed its purchase of AT&T's remaining 70% stake on 2 July 2025 and made DIRECTV a wholly owned portfolio company. Ownership is purely private equity with no state stake. Human-rights relevance is ordinary media/consumer labour and contractor conduct.
